QUOTE: `skipSync: true` | add path (hardcoded) | `sanitizeReactions` returns early with `deleteReactions: []`, so the add event never deletes stale reactions for that post. Only the create set is computed.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that skipSync on the single-reaction add prevents deletion of the post's other local reactions (which full sync mode would delete as missing from the payload).
